description: Generate a publication-style schematic of the prokaryotic Moco biosynthesis pathway (GTP to Mo-MPT and dinucleotide variants)
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 8.5))
ax.set_xlim(0, 14); ax.set_ylim(0, 9); ax.axis('off')
ax.set_title("Prokaryotic molybdenum cofactor biosynthesis: GTP → Mo-MPT → (optional) dinucleotide variants",
             fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)

# colors per stage
c = {'s1':'#cfe8ff','s2':'#d7f0d0','s3':'#ffe0b3','s4':'#f3d0e8'}

def node(x, y, w, h, text, color, fontsize=9):
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x, y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.02,rounding_size=0.12",
                         linewidth=1.2, edgecolor='#333', facecolor=color)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    ax.text(x+w/2, y+h/2, text, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize, wrap=True)

def arrow(x1,y1,x2,y2, label=None, ls='-', color='#333'):
    a = FancyArrowPatch((x1,y1),(x2,y2), arrowstyle='-|>', mutation_scale=16,
                        linewidth=1.6, color=color, linestyle=ls)
    ax.add_patch(a)
    if label:
        ax.text((x1+x2)/2, (y1+y2)/2+0.28, label, ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8, color=color)

# Metabolite nodes (top row) y=6.7
mety=6.9; mh=0.9; mw=1.7
node(0.2, mety, mw, mh, "GTP", '#eeeeee', 10)
node(2.6, mety, mw, mh, "3',8-cH$_2$GTP", '#eeeeee', 9)
node(5.0, mety, mw, mh, "cPMP\n(precursor Z)", '#eeeeee', 8.5)
node(7.4, mety, mw, mh, "MPT", '#eeeeee', 10)
node(9.8, mety, mw, mh, "MPT-AMP", '#eeeeee', 9)
node(12.1, mety, mw, mh, "Mo-MPT", '#eeeeee', 9.5)

# enzyme arrows between metabolites
arrow(1.9, mety+mh/2, 2.6, mety+mh/2, "MoaA")
arrow(4.3, mety+mh/2, 5.0, mety+mh/2, "MoaC")
arrow(6.7, mety+mh/2, 7.4, mety+mh/2, "MPT synthase")
arrow(9.1, mety+mh/2, 9.8, mety+mh/2, "MogA/MoaB")
arrow(11.5, mety+mh/2, 12.1, mety+mh/2, "MoeA")

# Stage bands (enzyme detail boxes) lower
node(0.2, 4.6, 4.1, 1.5,
     "STAGE 1  cPMP formation (obligatory)\nMoaA: radical-SAM GTP 3',8-cyclase\n(2×[4Fe-4S]; SAM→5'-dAdo•)\nMoaC: rearrangement → cPMP", c['s1'], 8)
node(4.6, 4.6, 4.0, 1.5,
     "STAGE 2  dithiolene install (obligatory)\nMoeB: adenylylates MoaD (E1-like)\nMoaD: Ubl thiocarboxylate sulfur carrier\nMoaD$_2$-MoaE$_2$: 2 S → C1'/C2'", c['s2'], 8)
node(8.8, 4.6, 2.6, 1.5,
     "STAGE 3  Mo insertion (obligatory)\nG-domain (MogA/MoaB):\nMPT+ATP→MPT-AMP\nE-domain (MoeA): +MoO$_4^{2-}$", c['s3'], 7.6)
node(11.6, 4.6, 2.2, 1.5,
     "STAGE 4 (conditional)\nnucleotide capping\nof Mo-MPT", c['s4'], 8)

# Stage 4 branch nodes
node(9.4, 2.2, 2.0, 1.1, "bis-MGD\n(MobA, +GMP)", c['s4'], 8.5)
node(11.7, 2.2, 2.0, 1.1, "MCD\n(MocA, +CMP)", c['s4'], 8.5)
node(7.1, 2.2, 2.0, 1.1, "Mo-MPT\n(retained)", '#eeeeee', 8.5)
arrow(12.9, mety, 12.7, 3.3, None)      # to branch region
arrow(12.6, 4.6, 10.4, 3.3, "MobA")
arrow(12.9, 4.6, 12.7, 3.3, "MocA")
arrow(12.2, 4.6, 8.1, 3.3, "(none)")

# client families
node(6.6, 0.5, 3.0, 1.1, "CLIENT: sulfite oxidase family", '#f7f7f7', 8)
node(8.9, 0.5, 2.6, 1.1, "CLIENT: DMSO reductase\nfamily (NarGHI...)", '#f7f7f7', 7.5)
node(11.5, 0.5, 2.4, 1.1, "CLIENT: xanthine\noxidase-type", '#f7f7f7', 7.5)
arrow(8.1, 2.2, 8.1, 1.6, None)
arrow(10.4, 2.2, 10.2, 1.6, None)
arrow(12.7, 2.2, 12.7, 1.6, None)

# dependency callouts
ax.text(6.6, 6.35, "IscS → (YnjE) sulfur supply", fontsize=7.5, color='#118', ha='center')
arrow(6.6, 6.2, 7.9, mety, None, ls='--', color='#118')
ax.text(1.05, 6.35, "ErpA/IscA\n[4Fe-4S]", fontsize=7, color='#118', ha='center')
arrow(1.05, 6.0, 1.6, mety, None, ls='--', color='#118')
ax.text(11.9, 6.35, "molybdate\n(ModABC)", fontsize=7, color='#118', ha='center')
arrow(11.9, 6.1, 12.0, mety, None, ls='--', color='#118')

# legend
handles=[mpatches.Patch(color=c['s1'],label='Stage 1: cPMP'),
         mpatches.Patch(color=c['s2'],label='Stage 2: MPT'),
         mpatches.Patch(color=c['s3'],label='Stage 3: Mo-MPT'),
         mpatches.Patch(color=c['s4'],label='Stage 4: dinucleotide (optional)')]
ax.legend(handles=handles, loc='lower left', fontsize=8, framealpha=0.9, ncol=2)
ax.text(0.2, 3.55, "Dashed blue = obligatory external dependencies (outside module scope)",
        fontsize=7.5, color='#118', style='italic')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('moco_pathway_schematic.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
print("Schematic saved. Modules: 4 stages, 9 core enzymes, 2 dinucleotide branches, 3 client families.")
